proceso: Antorcha apagada (sustituye a la vela, revisión en vivo): master → 3D

pasos.prompt: Game prop design of an unlit hand-held wooden torch (antorcha apagada) for the throne room of a castle, for an isometric escape room game. A sturdy wooden stick handle, wrapped near the top with dark cloth strips and a bundle of dry straw and tow soaked in resin forming the torch head, ready to be lit but currently unlit: no fire, no flame, no glow, no embers, no smoke, no sparks. Same warm dark wood tone as other wooden props, dark grey-brown cloth wrap. Chunky simple bold shapes, no fine engravings, no text. Resting diagonally as if lying on the ground, handle end at lower-right, torch head at upper-left. Seen in a three-quarter view slightly from above, whole object visible and centered. Exactly the same stylized 3D toon rendering, soft shading, saturated colors and soft upper-left lighting as the reference image. Edges defined only by light and shading, no outline. Isolated on a flat uniform light grey background, no floor, no shadow, no text.
